tagline.en: Meituan LongCat's MIT-licensed video model, tuned for long-video generation and continuation.
tagline.zh: 美团 LongCat 推出的 MIT 许可视频模型,擅长长视频生成与续写。

en: LongCat-Video is an open video-generation model from Meituan's LongCat team, released under the MIT license. Alongside text-to-video and image-to-video, its emphasis is on longer clips and video continuation — extending an existing video rather than only starting from scratch.

In WorldFoundry it runs through a model-specific pipeline that drives the vendored demo scripts once you explicitly request execution, using local LongCat-Video checkpoints. You supply your prompt or seed video, and it generates the continuation or clip.
zh: LongCat-Video 是美团 LongCat 团队开源的视频生成模型,采用 MIT 许可。除了文生视频与图生视频,它更侧重较长片段与视频续写——在已有视频基础上延展,而不只是从零开始。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过一条专用 pipeline 运行,在你显式请求执行后驱动内置的 demo 脚本,并使用本地 LongCat-Video checkpoint。你提供提示词或起始视频,它便生成续写或片段。

whenToUse.en: A good fit when you want longer generated video or need to continue an existing clip, and want an openly-licensed (MIT) model for it.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要更长的生成视频、或需要续写已有片段,并希望使用一个开放许可(MIT)的模型时,它很合适。

notFor.en: Checkpoints are staged locally rather than bundled, and the pipeline runs only when you explicitly request execution, so set both up before you generate.
notFor.zh: Checkpoint 需在本地准备而非随附,且 pipeline 只在你显式请求执行时才运行,请在生成前把两者都配置好。

en: Focus on long-video generation and continuation
zh: MIT 许可,权重开放可用
专注长视频生成与续写
同时支持文生视频与图生视频
